import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n, k = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    limit = 10**18
    # All positive powers of k up to 10^18 (at most 60 of them).
    powers = set()
    p = k
    while True:
        powers.add(p)
        if p > limit // k:
            break
        p *= k
    print(sum(1 for x in data[2:2 + n] if int(x) in powers))


main()
